title: Real Estate Rental Company Seeking Loan in Geneva, Switzerland
tagline: The business is a healthcare real estate investment and leasing platform focused on supporting the expansion of an affiliated medical network. - It operates through a dedicated Swiss property company that holds healthcare premises separately from the group's clinical operations. - The business generates revenue through long-term property leases with affiliated healthcare operators. - Its lease agreements are indexed to inflation, providing a mechanism for rental income adjustments. - The property acquisition and development model includes purchasing existing clinic buildings and fitting out new locations. - The business follows a strategic expansion plan covering Switzerland, Luxembourg, France, Belgium, Monaco, Spain, Portugal, and the United Arab Emirates. - Future expansion markets include Canada, Brazil, and the United States. - These markets are selected based on existing group connections, language compatibility, and planned healthcare development. - The business operates with five employees and has three directors. Its property-level financing structure is designed to separate real estate financing from clinical operations. - The investment platform can be financed independently or alongside the wider permanent-capital structure. Investors may participate through equity or preferred shares, depending on the proposed investment arrangement. - The business generates high revenue with a lean team of five employees through its healthcare real estate model. Revenue is primarily driven by long-term lease agreements with affiliated healthcare operators rather than labour-intensive services. The company focuses on acquiring and fitting out clinic properties for rental income, allowing it to scale its property portfolio without significantly increasing headcount. Inflation-indexed leases can also support rental income growth over time.
